Uru Co-founder Akshar Halgali, the best food stories often begin with a dish that makes you stop and wonder what makes it so good.

Over the years, that curiosity has drawn him into conversations with chefs and home chefs, introduced him to new flavours and led him to recreate amazing dishes in his own kitchen. The House Roast Chicken began with one such discovery, at a night market in Goa. The chicken was so juicy and memorable that Akshar wanted to understand what made it work. What followed was six months of experimenting, learning and getting it just right.

Eventually, the Halgali House Roast Chicken became a favourite amongst friends at every BYOB party and many family gatherings. Now, this much-loved roast chicken is available for you at Uru on the Halgali Menu. 

Come pull up a chair and taste the Halgali Menu, only at URU.

#HalgaliMenu #Bengaluru #Food #InstaFood #IndianFood

Akshar Halgali’s love for food has always been closely tied to the people around him. The recipes he grew up with, the things his family loves, and even the unexpected dishes that came from simply making do.

There’s the fish fry he grew up eating at home, there’s the combination of pepper chicken and biryani that his son loves, and a lockdown experiment with beetroot that everyone wants more of. 

Different dishes, different memories, but each one has a place in Akshar Halgali’s food stories. And that’s what makes the Halgali Menu feel so personal. It isn’t just a collection of recipes, but a collection of moments he’s chosen to share.

Come pull up a chair and discover the Halgali Menu. Brought to you by Uru co-founder Akshar Halgali.

#HalgaliMenu #Bengaluru #Food #InstaFood #IndianFood

If you talk to Akshar Halgali about food, you’ll quickly realise there’s a story behind almost everything he loves to eat.

A rainy evening in childhood. His son’s favourite Sunday lunch. Unforgettable street food from a Goan holiday. Over the years, these memories have shaped the way Akshar Halgali cooks and some of them have now found their way to Uru.

What makes these recipes special isn’t just how they taste. They carry a little bit of where Akshar has been, what he’s loved and the people he’s shared them with.

Come hungry, pull up a chair and make a few food memories of your own with the Halgali Menu. Brought to you by Uru Co-founder Akshar Halgali.

To Akshar Halgali, food is more than what’s on the plate. It’s a memory, a feeling, a story worth sharing.
A true food lover, Akshar has spent years discovering, collecting and cooking recipes that have meant something to him. Some come from late night cooking with hostel friends, some from places he’s travelled to, and others from childhood summers in the village of Halgali. 

The Native Brinjal Pot is one such memory. A recipe passed down through generations of his family—from his great-grandmother to his grandmother, his mother and her sisters, and to Akshar. Now, he’s bringing that little piece of home to URU.

This is the Halgali Menu, a curated collection of unforgettable food by Uru Co-founder Akshar Halgali. 
Come pull up a chair and taste the Halgali Menu, only at URU.
